description: SET or REMOVE the attributes on the brand’s Google Business Profile listing — accessibility, amenities, service options, payment types, the booking/menu links Google keeps as attributes — which are what local searchers FILTER on. Find each attribute’s name and allowed values with list_business_attributes first. set: [{name:"attributes/has_wheelchair_accessible_entrance", values:[true]}, {name:"attributes/url_menu", uriValues:[{uri:"https://…"}]}, {name:"attributes/pay_credit_card_types_accepted", repeatedEnumValue:{setValues:["visa"]}}] — exactly one value kind per attribute. unset: ["attributes/…"] removes one. Nothing outside set + unset is touched. CALL IT WITHOUT confirm FIRST: it reads what Google has now and returns the exact before and after, changing nothing; then confirm:true once the user approves. Public and immediate on Search and Maps. 0 credits.

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user saw the before and after

locationId.description: which listing (locations/…), from list_business_locations — only needed when more than one is shared with this profile

set.description: attributes to set: {name, values | uriValues | repeatedEnumValue}

name: update_business_attributes
title: Set Google listing attributes
